channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Brian Windhorst | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Brian Windhorst from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Pablo Torre on Sam Presti, Brian Windhorst
item.description:
“And the question of like, ‘Why would he do that?’ The reason that Sam Presti kicked the tires on hiring Brian Windhorst from ESPN is that information to Sam Presti is currency. It is an edge, a competitive advantage. And you don’t surrender that information.”

Pablo Torre on Sam Presti, Brian Windhorst, Jun 12, 2025. Source: Awful Announcing.

item.title: Pablo Torre on Brian Windhorst
item.description:
“One thing I can report is that a little over a decade ago, he actually explored our extremely plugged-in buddy, Brian Windhorst, away from ESPN, to work as an information guy for the Thunder,”

Pablo Torre on Brian Windhorst, Jun 12, 2025. Source: Awful Announcing.

item.title: Cam Johnson on Brian Windhorst, Deandre Ayton
item.description:
“And next thing you know, whoever it was,Windy (ESPN’s Brian Windhorst) or somebody on the TV was like naming the potential trade targets. Naming DA (Deandre Ayton), me, Mikal (Bridges). And I was like, come on man, but it’s the business.”

Cam Johnson on Brian Windhorst, Deandre Ayton, Jul 31, 2022. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Magic Johnson on LeBron James, Brian Windhorst
item.description:
Magic Johnson:

“First, Brian [Windhorst] got it wrong. This is all about making sure that they can say something on ESPN and everybody can just talk. We have a system that the ball moves around, a lot of pick-and-roll plays. If you watch us play, the ball is not in LeBron James’ hands all of the time. It can’t be because you want to pass it around, you get into your pick-and-roll plays. But hey, we’re the Lakers. People are going to be talking about us, but that’s not how it’s going right now.”

Magic Johnson on LeBron James, Brian Windhorst, Nov 29, 2018. Source: lebronwire.usatoday.com.
